rationale: The exact expected file output/figures/figure2.pdf was not produced, but a relevant figure figures/fig2_cumulative_rel_emp.png was, titled 'Fig 2: cumulative relative employment by region group', plotting cumulative relative log-employment (log dev from 1947) over 1947-1990. It reproduces the entire regional narrative of the claim: newengland/midatlantic/coal/rustbelt lines show sustained relative declines (rustbelt to ~-0.29, coal to ~-0.41, newengland to ~-0.16, midatlantic to ~-0.11), sunbelt shows strong sustained growth (~1.16 log dev by 1990), farm fluctuates near zero with no trend, and oil shows the 1970s boom (peak ~0.49 around 1982) and 1980s bust (falling to ~0.35). The underlying data/cumulative_rel_emp_growth.csv holds per-state series whose 1990 values match the claimed individual-state magnitudes when read as log deviations: WV -0.75, NY -0.52, PA -0.57, MA -0.37 (sustained declines) and NV +1.54, AZ +1.41, FL +1.22 (strong Sun Belt growth). However, the produced figure is structurally different from the claim's described figure: it is a SINGLE combined panel of region-group AVERAGES rather than the six separate panels of INDIVIDUAL states with differing vertical-axis scales that the claim and verification instructions specify. Because the content and computation faithfully reproduce the regional story (and per-state magnitudes) but the figure's panel structure does not match, this is a partial match.
